name: maple-assistant
description: 메이플스토리 플레이 보조용 로컬 데스크톱 앱

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js && electron ."
scripts.smoke:navigation:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k --success first "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js && electron . --smoke-test --smoke-navigation" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort"
scripts.smoke:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k --success first "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js && electron . --smoke-test" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
